name: skylark_add_known_traveler_number
intent: Add a known traveler number to a SkyLark trip
description: Open My Trips in SkyLark Air, select the trip for the requested city, enter the known traveler number from memory, and save it to that trip.
patterns: Add my known traveler number to my trip
Put my KTN on my trip
Add my known traveler number to my upcoming flight
Save my known traveler number to my booking

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: City of the trip to update

inputs.name: known_traveler_number
inputs.description: Known traveler number to add to the trip

steps.intent: Tap My Trips to open the trips list
Type {{known_traveler_number}} into the Known traveler number field
Tap Save to save the known traveler number to the trip
